Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID]

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

View: SalesLT.vGetAllCategories
Columns:
  - ParentProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryName (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductCategoryID (INTEGER)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vGetAllCategories]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- Returns the CustomerID, first name, and last name for the specified customer.

WITH CategoryCTE([ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]) AS 
(
	SELECT [ParentProductCategoryID], [ProductCategoryID], [Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory
	WHERE ParentProductCategoryID IS NULL

UNION ALL

	SELECT C.[ParentProductCategoryID], C.[ProductCategoryID], C.[Name]
	FROM SalesLT.ProductCategory AS C
	INNER JOIN CategoryCTE AS BC ON BC.ProductCategoryID = C.ParentProductCategoryID
)

SELECT PC.[Name] AS [ParentProductCategoryName], CCTE.[Name] as [ProductCategoryName], CCTE.[ProductCategoryID]  
FROM CategoryCTE AS CCTE
JOIN SalesLT.ProductCategory AS PC 
ON PC.[ProductCategoryID] = CCTE.[ParentProductCategoryID]

View: SalesLT.vProductAndDescription
Description: Product names and descriptions. Product descriptions are provided in multiple languages.
Columns:
  - ProductID (INTEGER) | Info: Clustered index on the view vProductAndDescription.
  - Name (NVARCHAR)
  - ProductModel (NVARCHAR)
  - Culture (NCHAR)
  - Description (NVARCHAR)
Definition:
CREATE VIEW [SalesLT].[vProductAndDescription] 
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS 
-- View (indexed or standard) to display products and product descriptions by language.
SELECT 
    p.[ProductID] 
    ,p.[Name] 
    ,pm.[Name] AS [ProductModel] 
    ,pmx.[Culture] 
    ,pd.[Description] 
FROM [SalesLT].[Product] p 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModel] pm 
    ON p.[ProductModelID] = pm.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductModelProductDescription] pmx 
    ON pm.[ProductModelID] = pmx.[ProductModelID] 
    INNER JOIN [SalesLT].[ProductDescription] pd 
    ON pmx.[ProductDescriptionID] = pd.[ProductDescriptionID];

The Customer table provides customer names, but it does not contain purchase information. The SalesOrderHeader and SalesOrderDetail tables are necessary to determine the number of purchases per customer. The current schemas do not include a direct way to count purchases, so these tables are required.

FROM SalesLT.Customer T1
JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail T3 ON T2.SalesOrderID = T3.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC

By joining these tables, we can count the number of purchases made by each customer and rank them in descending order.

SELECT TOP 10 T1.Name, COUNT(T3.SalesOrderID) as PurchaseCount
FROM SalesLT.Customer T1
INNER JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
INNER JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail T3 ON T2.SalesOrderID = T3.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC
parsed_result.reasoning: To solve this problem, we need to join the Customer, SalesOrderHeader, and SalesOrderDetail tables. The Customer table contains the customer names, the SalesOrderHeader table contains the sales order information, and the SalesOrderDetail table contains the individual products associated with each sales order. We join these tables on their respective keys: CustomerID and SalesOrderID. We then group the results by customer name and count the number of sales orders for each customer. Finally, we order the results by the purchase count in descending order to get the customers with the most purchases at the top.

GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC

FROM SalesLT.Customer T1
JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail T3 ON T2.SalesOrderID = T3.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC

SELECT TOP 10 T1.Name, COUNT(T3.SalesOrderID) as PurchaseCount
FROM SalesLT.Customer T1
INNER JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
INNER JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail T3 ON T2.SalesOrderID = T3.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC
parsed_result.reasoning: To solve this problem, we need to join the Customer, SalesOrderHeader, and SalesOrderDetail tables. The Customer table contains the customer names, the SalesOrderHeader table contains the sales order information, and the SalesOrderDetail table contains the individual products associated with each sales order. We join these tables on their respective keys: CustomerID and SalesOrderID. We then group the results by customer name and count the number of sales orders for each customer. Finally, we order the results by the purchase count in descending order to get the customers with the most purchases at the top.

SELECT TOP 10 T1.Name, COUNT(T3.SalesOrderID) AS PurchaseCount
FROM SalesLT.Customer T1
INNER JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
INNER JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail T3 ON T2.SalesOrderID = T3.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC
parsed_result.reasoning: To solve this problem, we need to join the Customer, SalesOrderHeader, and SalesOrderDetail tables. The Customer table contains the customer names, the SalesOrderHeader table contains the sales order information, and the SalesOrderDetail table contains the individual products associated with each sales order. We join these tables on their respective keys: CustomerID and SalesOrderID. We then group the results by customer name and count the number of sales orders for each customer. Finally, we sort the results in descending order by the purchase count.

FROM SalesLT.Customer T1
JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderHeader T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN SalesLT.SalesOrderDetail T3 ON T2.SalesOrderID = T3.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY T1.Name
ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC

The SalesOrderHeader table contains the customer ID and sales order ID, and the SalesOrderDetail table contains the sales order ID and product information. By joining these tables, we can count the number of purchases made by each customer and rank them in descending order.
